html:
TermDefinition
DerivativeThe limit of the ratio of the change in a function to the change in its input; it gives the slope of the tangent line.
IntegralA limit of sums that measures accumulated change, such as the area under a curve.
LimitThe value that a function approaches as its input gets arbitrarily close to a chosen point.
MatrixA rectangular array of numbers arranged in rows and columns.
DeterminantA single number computed from a square matrix that tells whether the matrix can be inverted.
EigenvalueA scalar by which a matrix stretches a special direction called an eigenvector.
VectorA quantity with both a size and a direction, often written as a column of numbers.
ScalarA quantity described by a single number and, in physics, a unit.
DomainThe set of all inputs for which a function is defined.
RangeThe set of all outputs that a function actually produces.
